title: David Escapes
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story you will hear how 
King Saul is so jealous of David 
that he wants to hurt David.
MEET THE BIBLE CHARACTERS IN TODAYS STORY

Last week you learnt that King Saul’s son - 
Jonathan was BEST FRIENDS with David

Today you will hear that Saul’s youngest daughter, 
Michal was in love with David
And David married her

BUT JEALOUS KING SAUL ACTUALLY WANTED TO TRAP DAVID!
Saul said David could marry her if he killed 100 Philistines!!!
HOPING DAVID WOULD DIE IN THE BATTLE!

King Saul knew that the LORD was with David and this made him afraid
Because the LORD was no longer with Saul
BECAUSE SAUL did NOT have a heart for the Lord
Saul disobeyed the LORD

DAVID and JONATHAN had HEARTS for the Lord

So when trouble was coming for David at home
Michal warned David
and helped him escape out the window 
before King Saul’s men came
When they arrived she told them that David was SICK IN BED
She tricked them buy putting a statue in the bed 
with some goats hair 
to make it look like David
SO DAVID ESCAPED and went to SAMUEL the PROPHET
